application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Works to trees protected by preservation order.
 Row
     of Lime Trees (G14) - Remove basal and epicormic growth and cut back to
     clear lamp post by 1m and strim around base.  1 x
     Chestnut (T44) - Tree is dead. Fell as low as possible and grind out stump       1 x
     Plane (G15) - To remove all major deadwood2 x
     Maples (T21/T22) - Remove all major deadwood  1 x
     Lime (T17) - Crown lift to 3m and remove basal growth.1x
     Lime  (T31) - Crown lift to 3m and remove basal growth
 1 x
     Chestnut (T32) - Crown lift to 3m and remove basal growth 1 x
     Lime Trees (T8) - Crown lift to 3m and remove basal growth.
 1 x
     Oak Tree (T10) - Crown lift to 3m and remove basal growth. Mixed
     species (W2)- Cut back trees from kerb by up to 1m, fell 2 dead trees as
     low as possible  Behind
     151& 132 Peterborough Road Cut back bramble vegetation back to
     boundary fence to allow 1m clearance.
 Mixed
     species (G5 13/92) - Reduction of all overhanging branches within this
     mixed-species group by approximately 2–3 metres, where they extend over
     neighbouring properties adjoining the Whipps Cross boundary.
